run_collect_openpose: run the script to collect OpenPose keypoints for a video sequence and save to pickle
summarize_collect_openpose: summarize the script that extracts body, hand, and face keypoints from OpenPose JSON results
review_collect_openpose: review the script that scores people by keypoint confidence and selects the most prominent person per frame
refactor_collect_openpose: refactor the script to accept sequence name, frame range, and person index via argparse
build_collect_openpose_cli: build a CLI module to collect OpenPose keypoints for configurable sequences and save to pickle
